timing_method: Interpretive estimates using card meanings, suit associations and symbolic timing. Not universal or guaranteed.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.upright: A fresh beginning, spontaneous opportunity or unexpected development.
cards.reversed: Hesitation, poor preparation or an unpredictable beginning.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.upright: Initiative, communication and resources coming together.
cards.reversed: Miscommunication, lack of focus or delayed action.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.upright: Hidden information, intuition and quiet developments.
cards.reversed: Confusion, secrets or information not yet revealed.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.upright: Growth, nurturing, abundance and gradual progress.
cards.reversed: Slow growth, lack of nurturing or creative blockage.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.upright: Structure, authority, planning and decisive progress.
cards.reversed: Rigidity, control issues or resistance to progress.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.upright: Tradition, commitment, institutions and steady progress.
cards.reversed: Resistance to convention or delays caused by formalities.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.upright: A meaningful choice, partnership or important connection.
cards.reversed: Indecision, miscommunication or relationship uncertainty.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.upright: Determination, movement and forward progress.
cards.reversed: Lack of direction, obstacles or delayed movement.

cards.name: Strength
cards.upright: Patience, courage and steady progress.
cards.reversed: Self-doubt, low confidence or slow progress.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.upright: Reflection, preparation and careful progress.
cards.reversed: Isolation, avoidance or prolonged uncertainty.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.upright: A turning point, changing circumstances or unexpected opportunity.
cards.reversed: Temporary setbacks, resistance to change or repeated patterns.

cards.name: Justice

cards.reversed: Unfairness, unresolved matters or administrative delays.

cards.name: The Hanged Man

cards.name: Death

cards.name: Temperance

cards.name: The Devil

cards.name: The Tower

cards.name: The Star

cards.name: The Moon

cards.reversed: Confusion gradually clearing or hidden information emerging.

cards.name: The Sun

cards.name: Judgement

cards.name: The World
